# JSTOR

> > JSTOR is a nonprofit digital library providing access to 2,800+ academic journals, 150,000+ ebooks, and 2M+ primary sources, operated by ITHAKA with products including Artstor, Workspace, JSTOR Daily, and Portico.

JSTOR serves students, researchers, and institutions with both free and subscription-based access to scholarly content. The platform includes innovative tools like AI-powered research assistants, specialized programs like JSTOR Access in Prison, and initiatives such as Path to Open for expanding open access publishing.

## Getting Started

- [JSTOR Home](https://jstor.org): Main homepage featuring digital library of journals, books, and primary sources
- [About JSTOR](https://about.jstor.org): Nonprofit mission overview featuring Digital Stewardship Services and products
- [Welcome! - How to Use JSTOR](https://guides.jstor.org/how-to-jstor): Getting started guide for using JSTOR's journals, ebooks, and images
- [About JSTOR - Platform Overview](https://guides.jstor.org/how-to-jstor/about-jstor): Platform overview: 2,800+ journals, 150K+ ebooks from ITHAKA nonprofit
- [JSTOR Mission](https://about.jstor.org/who-we-are/mission): Mission statement: expanding knowledge access via Workspace, Path to Open, ASPIRE

## Products & Services

- [JSTOR Products & Services](https://about.jstor.org/products): Full product suite: Digital Stewardship, Artstor, Books, and JSTOR Daily
- [Journals & Primary Sources](https://about.jstor.org/products/journals-and-primary-sources): 2,800+ journals and 2M+ primary sources for academic research
- [JSTOR AI Research Tool](https://about.jstor.org/products/jstor-platform/features-and-tools/research-tool): AI research tool for natural language search and content discovery
- [JSTOR for Students & Researchers](https://about.jstor.org/students-and-researchers): Student/researcher access options including JPASS and Workspace tools
- [JSTOR Daily](https://daily.jstor.org/about): JSTOR Daily magazine contextualizing events with scholarly research
- [Firefly Platform](https://firefly.jstor.org): Firefly platform homepage for primary sources and research collections
- [JSTOR Access in Prison](https://about.jstor.org/jstor-access-in-prison/faq): Prison education program with Mediated JSTOR and offline access solutions

## Support & Help

- [JSTOR Support](https://support.jstor.org/hc/en-us): Main support hub for login help, research tools, and Workspace assistance
- [Need Help Logging in to JSTOR?](https://support.jstor.org/hc/en-us/articles/360000313328-Need-Help-Logging-in-to-JSTOR): Login assistance for institutional, SSO, and off-campus access methods
- [Free Access to JSTOR](https://support.jstor.org/hc/en-us/sections/360009699953-Free-Access-to-JSTOR): Free registration guide for personal accounts, free reads, and open access
- [Searching and Citations](https://support.jstor.org/hc/en-us/sections/115001391007-Searching-and-Citations): Search help: Boolean operators, semantic results, Artstor images, citations
- [Tutorials](https://support.jstor.org/hc/en-us/p/tutorials): Video tutorials and LibGuides for JSTOR, Artstor, and admin training

## Librarian & Educator Resources

- [JSTOR LibGuides](https://guides.jstor.org): LibGuides hub for librarians and educators with reusable teaching resources
- [LibGuides Home](https://guides.jstor.org/home): Teaching resources for librarians including Artstor and Research Basics guides
- [JSTOR Training and Teaching](https://guides.jstor.org/for-libraries/training): Library training resources including Quick Start handout and orientation
- [Resources Archive](https://about.jstor.org/resource): Resource archive with toolkits for AI tools, Path to Open, and collections

## Innovation & Labs

- [JSTOR Labs](https://labstest.jstor.org): JSTOR Labs innovation hub exploring future research tools and projects
- [JSTOR Labs - About](https://labstest.jstor.org/about): JSTOR Labs about page: Design Thinking and Lean Startup methodology
- [Text Analyzer Project](https://labs.jstor.org/projects/text-analyzer): Text Analyzer project (graduated Aug 2024) inspired Constellate and AI tools
